The old town is one of the best places in the city. Nina and Ben had great fun there. Nina drinks juice after doing sports. For example, the parking meter ate my coins.
Ben is interested in drawing. Nina learned a lot about history. Nina thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. The baggage allowance is twenty kilos.
Nina hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Last Monday, Nina and Ben went to the old town. The weather was rainy that day. Also, the minibar prices made her laugh.
Nina plays volleyball with Ben every Monday. Nina is going to travel to Xi'an in December. There are always many people at the train station.
